title: Feature request: Widget for round smartwatch
symptom: A new Android widget for round smartwatches is requested. The user finds it complicated to change application options with small letters on their watch, and wants large numbers and arrows and the ability to stop alarms easily without accessing the menu.
evidence_quote: A new Android widget for round smartwatches. With large numbers and arrows and the ability to stop alarms easily without having to access the menu.
